title: Phase 1 lane → Phase 2 integration contract
description: Emitted by every Phase 1 lane when it finishes, at .fleet/results/<lane>.json in the lane's worktree. Phase 2 refuses to merge a lane whose result does not validate, or whose demo has not been verified by a DIFFERENT agent than the one that built it.

tasks.description: Backlog task ids this lane closed. Must match what the lane was assigned — a lane that closed something it was not given is a scope breach and blocks the merge.

filesTouched.description: Used by Phase 2 to compute the real collision set before merging, rather than discovering it during the merge.

migrations.description: Empty unless this lane was assigned a reserved number in foundation.contract.json. A migration not reserved there is a hard failure.

reversibilityNote.description: Migrations are forward-only here (server/db/migrate.js has no down). State plainly how to recover if this one is wrong.

suiteAdded.description: Lanes MUST NOT append to server/check-api.js. New assertions go in a new file registered in the manifest. This is what keeps eight lanes from fighting over one 3375-line file.

allSuitesPass.description: Run with REQUIRE_DB=1. A SKIP counts as a failure.

decisionCompliance.description: Per the Workflow Review Gate already defined in AGENTS.md. A lane self-reports here; Phase 4 re-checks independently and its verdict wins.

decisionsRead.description: There are 30 records in backlog/decisions/. Reading fewer means the lane did not read them all.

newDecisionNeeded.description: If the lane had to make a call that contradicts an accepted decision, it does NOT proceed. It stops and names the decision that would have to be superseded. Decisions change only by supersession (AGENTS.md).

status.description: NEEDS_HUMAN is not failure. Physical-hardware proof and store review cannot be done by an agent and must surface as NEEDS_HUMAN rather than being faked or silently skipped.

handoff.description: What the next agent needs to know that is not in the diff.
